 Watch LASK vs Slovan Bratislava live today: TV and live stream details
 DAZN will show the Champions League match between LASK and Slovan Bratislava live, with a stream available directly through the service.
 Talking points of the week: What has been happening at LASK and Slovan Bratislava?
 LASK go into this match with four wins and one defeat from their last five competitive outings. Most recently, they beat WSG Tirol 2-1 at home in the Austrian Bundesliga. Their 5-4 cup match against Ried showed both the Linz side's attacking strength and their defensive vulnerability. In the Champions League, they most recently won 3-2 away at Sporting CP. Across those five matches, LASK scored 14 goals and conceded nine.
 Four wins, one draw and one defeat make up Slovan Bratislava's recent record. Their only setback was the 4-0 defeat against AS Roma in the Champions League. Since then, Slovan have won two consecutive league matches, most recently beating Zeleziarne Podbrezova 2-1 away. A 2-2 draw against Dukla Banska Bystrica was the only time they dropped points in the league. Slovan scored eleven goals and conceded eight in their last five matches.
